records.title: Story Check Grounding Integrity
records.description: Exact-source identity/hash verification for Story Check diagnostics. Every factual warning carries source identity, content hash, verification state (verified/unverified/quarantined), and validator outcome. Unsourced claims are quarantined; unverified structural diagnostics are preserved with correct status.

records.title: Roadmap Governance
records.description: Roadmap control layer with immutable parent task IDs, enrichment validation, deterministic roadmap validator, and child-task sequencing. Roadmap truth is controlled by roadmap_index.yaml, implementation_status.md, and validation records.

records.title: Project Memory Authority Foundation
records.description: Defined seven-tier authority hierarchy, eight trust classes, commit-bound freshness model, supersession rules, conflicting-evidence resolution, owner-decision representation, generated-evidence requirements, memory-update approval, roadmap synchronization, stale-index behavior, tool provenance, prompt-injection boundaries, branch synchronization policy, and product boundaries.

records.title: Normalized Registry Architecture
records.description: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 schema bundle with typed $defs; 12 tracked normalized registry files; registry manifest; dependency-free standard-library validator; stable namespaced identifiers; enforced trust classes, lifecycle values, source locator validation, and cross-record reference integrity.

records.title: Deterministic Scanners
records.description: Read-only deterministic scanners that inspect repository state (code, tests, roadmap decisions, task records, enrichment data) and produce normalized evidence records with convergence criteria for plan-vs-implementation comparison.
